title: VTDexManip
about: Human right-hand manipulation with a 20-pad piezoresistive tactile glove and an egocentric HoloLens 2 camera, one glove frame per video frame: 2,032 sequences, 10 tasks, 182 objects, 5 subjects.

hardware.d: 4 per finger, 3 on the thumb, 1 on the palm · released as pad voltages (V), one frame per video frame · the glove transmits at 200 Hz (paper)
424×240 RGB PNG frames · frame rate not stated in the release
10 tasks; no object label, hand pose or depth

notes: Data: password-protected OneDrive folder (password in the GitHub README), CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 for academic use per its License.txt; the code (github.com/LQTS/VTDexManip) is MIT. The release has no frame rate or timestamps; the viewer assumes 30 fps, the rate of the authors' own visualization script. Videos are the release's PNG frames re-encoded to H.264 and re-hosted under the same license.
